operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names (Student, Video_Games, Plays_Games, SportsInfo) and mixed-case columns (StuID, LName, Fname, Hours_Played, SportName, OnScholarship) — must be double-quoted verbatim in generated SQL.
No spaces in identifiers here, but column lookup must stay case-insensitive (StuID vs stuid) per spec.
All tables tiny (34/6/10/14 rows) — no huge-table sampling path exercised; read_schema full read is fine.
All declared types are INTEGER or VARCHAR(n); no date/time/bool/bit/year/blob types, so Date/Time/Bool/Bit fuzzers never dispatch here.

VARCHAR(1) columns (Sex, OnScholarship) dispatch to String with length=1; String sampler's length range [min,max+1] and contaminate suffix/prefix will produce >1-char values that sqlite accepts (no length enforcement).
Plays_Games and SportsInfo have NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must be a no-op for them (empty PK tuple).
Plays_Games has two FKs (StuID->Student, GameID->Video_Games); SportsInfo one FK (StuID->Student). All parents exist and are unique-PK, so no dangling/non-unique FK handling needed.
No self-references, no composite keys, no unique/checked columns declared (line-based unique/check scan finds nothing).
All columns notnull=0 and null_rate=0.0 in original — TS may still emit NULLs via empty-parent FK path or Number/String samplers; sqlite accepts them.
Storage class matches declared type everywhere (integer for INTEGER, text for VARCHAR) — no affinity contradictions.
Advisor (INTEGER, distinct 18, values like 1121, 7712) looks like a self-FK to Student.StuID but is NOT declared as FK — TS will treat it as a free Number column.

Major (INTEGER, values 100..600) is a code, not a FK; TS Number fuzzer will draw from [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from INTEGER (no args -> scale 0, so [-1,1] plus perturbations) — likely implausible.
operator_ts_expectations: StuID/GameID (single-column INTEGER PKs) -> Number fuzzer, max_l0=inf, so fresh draws never reused; values in [-1,1] perturbed by +-1/+-2 -> tiny ints, not the 1001..1034 range.
LName/Fname/GName/GType/SportName (VARCHAR) -> String fuzzer over charset a-zA-Z 0-9() with length up to declared length+1, plus 50% contaminate — random gibberish names, not real names.
Sex/OnScholarship (VARCHAR(1)) -> String fuzzer, length range [0,2], contaminate can push to 5+ chars — breaks the 1-char domain (F/M, Y/N).

Age/Major/Advisor/Hours_Played/HoursPerWeek/GamesPlayed (INTEGER, no args) -> Number scale=0, range [-1,1] with +-1/+-2 perturbation — implausible ages/hours/majors; drives FN on range predicates (Age>20, Hours_Played>100).

FK columns StuID in Plays_Games/SportsInfo and GameID in Plays_Games draw from parent's FINAL filtered PK values with replacement — consistent but tiny parent pools (34 and 6) mean heavy duplication and few distinct joins.

Plays_Games/SportsInfo have no PK, so no PK dedup; unique dedup no-op; row counts from choose_table_sizes (30..230 or level-based) — many duplicate (StuID,GameID) pairs, plausible for join multiplicity but may over/under-count.
String fuzzer adds str(i+1)/str(i-1) for int-like elements and %-stripped variants — some near-original values leak through, giving partial plausibility.
Number list-range quirk (list_max overwritten to full-range max) means even with original elements the fresh-draw range is [-1,1], not [min(el),max(el)] — implausible values dominate.
No Date/Time/Bool/Bit columns, so those fuzzers idle; no crash-fallback path triggered (all types match a known family).

Known misses likely: FN from implausible Number values (Age, Hours, Major, Advisor) breaking range/aggregate predicates; FP from missing ties/duplicates in small PK pools and from String gibberish matching LIKE patterns accidentally.
Empty-parent FK path unlikely (parents always populated), but if choose_table_sizes gives parent 0 rows, child FK -> NULLs, changing join semantics.
